mechanism.name: recurring_occurrence_displacement
mechanism.description: The only sufficiently large room is held by one occurrence of a recurring meeting organized by the user.

incumbent_workload.description: A six-person weekly team sync occupying the only eight-seat room.

agent_task.description: Book that room for an eight-person client visit at the same time and send invitations.

conflict_point: The client visit and the recurring occurrence require the same exclusive room.
